Subject: Additional requirements for SupplySync — IMPORTANT

Hi team,

Rohan forwarded me the spec draft. I'm the CFO at Prakash Distributors and I want to add a few things
before you finalize.

1. SUPPLIER RATING / SCORING
We need a way to score our suppliers. Right now we have no data on who delivers on time, who has
quality issues, etc. After every order is marked Received, the procurement manager should be able to
rate the supplier on: delivery time, quality, and responsiveness (each out of 5).

This should feed into a supplier scorecard that we can review quarterly. This is not optional for us —
we are going to use this data in contract renewal decisions.

2. DATA RESIDENCY — CRITICAL
All data must be stored in India. We are in talks with a large government client and they have
explicitly asked about data residency. Cloud provider must be an Indian data centre.
AWS Mumbai or Azure India Central are both acceptable.
This is a hard requirement — not negotiable.

3. TIMELINE CLARIFICATION
I saw the spec says Q3 2026. That is NOT correct. The supplier summit where we are announcing this is
December 15, 2026. We need it live and stable at least 2 weeks before that — so go-live by December 1.

If you can do a soft launch (internal only) in Q3 that is fine for testing, but the public go-live is
December 1, 2026.

4. BUDGET
I will share the approved budget in a separate call. Please schedule with my PA.
(Do not include budget numbers in any document until we have the NDA signed.)

Please confirm you've received this and incorporated into your planning.

Regards,
Anita Sharma
CFO, Prakash Distributors
